description: This file defines a final Swift class 'WatchReplyCoordinator' responsible for managing watch reply events, including deduplication, queuing when the gateway is disconnected, and draining or requeuing events.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A class that manages watch reply events, handling deduplication, queuing, and forwarding of events based on connection state.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes a WatchQuickReplyEvent, decides whether to drop, deduplicate, queue, or forward based on reply ID and connection status.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns queued events if the gateway is connected, clearing the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Reinserts an event at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued reply events.
